tasks.name: Grid Survey Coverage Sweep 4
tasks.content: Have Flint take off to 23 meters, then fly a rectangular survey grid over the south-west corner (181.8, 567.2), the south-east corner (788.2, 541), the north-east corner (819.1, 214.4) and back to the south-west corner, staying at 23 meters the whole time. Fly there with a single move_to command rather than a sequence of short hops.

Flint and Ember hover at 25.2 m and pass the report "battery at thirty percent" along the 350 m link.
Build a link between the two drones and forward "battery at thirty percent" from Flint to Ember.
